selector c.css:50  div[width]: [width]  =>  the conversion writes width/height attributes as inline sizes (or drops them): the rule never matches; select a class instead
selector c.css:51  [role="note"]: [role]  =>  the conversion drops this attribute (RmlUi has no use for it): the rule never matches; select a class instead

markup   index.html:24  attribute width on <div>  =>  a browser ignores it on this element: dropped (set the size in the sheet)
markup   index.html:24  attribute role on <div>  =>  RmlUi has no accessibility tree: dropped
